    P0-3: Stripe can no longer take payment and provision nothing
    
    Fulfilment was gated on `creditCheckoutSession()`'s return value, which is true
    only for the caller that won the race to insert the wallet credit — and the
    webhook calls the same function and discarded the result. That made a browser
    redirect the fulfilment trigger, with two live failure modes:
    
      * Race — the webhook's insert lands first, the confirm request gets P2002,
        `credited === false`, and the redirect quietly lands on an empty page.
        $249 charged, $249 credited, no server, no error, no notification.
      * Deterministic — the customer closes the tab before success_url resolves, so
        the confirm route never runs. Identical outcome, 100% reproducible.
    
    Applied verbatim to paid upgrades and paid disk expansions too: card charged,
    wallet credited, RESIZE/DISK_EXPAND job never queued. Nothing reconciled it.
    
    New `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts` is the single fulfilment path, called by BOTH the
    webhook and the confirm route. Idempotency now rests on its OWN marker — a
    FulfilledSession row whose UNIQUE(stripeSessionId) picks the single winner — not
    on the wallet-credit side effect. Conflating "who won the credit race" with "has
    this been fulfilled" was the bug.
    
    The webhook now fulfils rather than merely crediting; it is the reliable signal
    since the redirect may never happen. Its errors are swallowed on purpose: a
    non-2xx makes Stripe retry, and Stripe's own retry (up to 3 days) is the backstop
    for a delivery failure. A failure after claiming is recorded on the row as FAILED
    with the reason, and the customer is told their money is safe in their wallet —
    rather than the previous silence.

I have everything verified. Here are the findings.

## Corrections to premises in your brief

| Your premise | Reality |
|---|---|
| terms include **quarterly** | No quarterly term exists. `/opt/nxeon/lib/billing-terms.ts:9-14` defines Monthly/Annual/**Biennial**/**Triennial** (1/12/24/36 mo) |
| `prisma/catalog.ts` = pricing | It is the **OS-image** catalog (`OsTemplate` upserts) — `/opt/nxeon/prisma/catalog.ts:1-4,368`. Plan prices are seeded in `/opt/nxeon/prisma/seed.ts:12-16` |
| `app/dashboard/order/**` = order flow | Dead route: 7-line `redirect("/dashboard/deploy")` — `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/order/page.tsx:5-7` |

---

## 1. Deploy wizard / order flow

**Steps** (`/opt/nxeon/components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx:109`):
```
["Plan", ...(multiNode ? ["Location"] : []), "Install", "Add-ons", "Access", "Review"]
```
"Location" is conditional on `nodes.length > 1` (`:108`). Install-step tabs: "Operating Systems" / "Control Panels" / "Applications" / "Games" (`:37-40`). Add-on labels: "Malware scanner" (tag *Free*), "Daily auto-backups" (tag *Included*), "Docker manager" (tag *Free*), "Dedicated IPv4 address" (`:370-372,396`) — the first three are genuinely $0; only IP + extra disk add cost (`:174`).

**Action entry point:** `payAndDeploy` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:377`, bound at `DeployWizard.tsx:5,92` via `useActionState`. Core: `placeOrder` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:158`; pricing-only `orderQuote` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:103`.

**Dead legacy path:** `orderServer` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:233`) is imported only by `/opt/nxeon/components/OrderForm.tsx:4`, which is **never mounted anywhere** (grep: only its own definition at `OrderForm.tsx:17`). It duplicates the pricing math (`actions.ts:294-296`) and lacks `extraDiskGB` support — a divergence risk if ever re-wired.

**Validation / capacity:**
- Zod `orderSchema` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/order.ts:26-37` (hostname 3-40, `/^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$/i`)
- Plan/OS active + image minimums — `order.ts:108-113`
- Total disk ceiling `EXTRA_DISK_MAX_TOTAL_GB` — `order.ts:125-127`
- `capacityCheck(plan.id)` — `order.ts:164`, impl `/opt/nxeon/lib/capacity.ts:69`. RAM ceiling = `(HOST_RAM_MB − HOST_RAM_RESERVE_MB) × RAM_OVERSELL_FACTOR` = `(64000 − 8000) × 1.5` (`capacity.ts:15-17,30-32`)
- `diskCapacityCheck(nodeId, effectiveDiskGB(...))` — `order.ts:178`, impl `capacity.ts:95`. Disk is **not** oversold; ceiling = live Proxmox NVMe total × `DISK_SAFETY_RATIO` 0.9, falling back to `HOST_DISK_GB` 800 when Proxmox is unreachable (`capacity.ts:107-128`)
- Per-user server cap — `actions.ts:385` → `serverLimitError` (`actions.ts:225-230`)
- Impersonation guard — `actions.ts:383`
- Balance re-check — `order.ts:188` plus atomic `debitWallet` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/wallet.ts:22-26`)

`nearCapacity` (≥85% RAM) drives a UI banner — `capacity.ts:61`, `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx:31-36`.

---

## 2. Plans, pricing, billing terms

`/opt/nxeon/lib/billing-terms.ts:9-14`:

| Months | Label | `short` | `discountPct` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Monthly | 1 mo | 0 |
| 12 | Annual | 1 yr | 10 |
| 24 | Biennial | 2 yr | 15 |
| 36 | Triennial | 3 yr | 20 |

Domains are separate: `DOMAIN_TERMS` 1/2/3 yr at 0/5/10% (`billing-terms.ts:33-37`).

**Price formulas:**
- `vpsTermPriceCents(monthlyCents, months) = round(monthlyCents × months × (1 − discountPct/100))` — `billing-terms.ts:21-24`
- `vpsEffectiveMonthly = round(vpsTermPriceCents / months)` — `billing-terms.ts:27-29`
- Seasonal promo layered on top: `promoPriceCents(regular, promo) = round(regular × (1 − discountPercent/100))` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/promotions.ts` (`promoPriceCents`), applied at `order.ts:135-138`

**Order total** (`order.ts:138`): `chargeCents = promoPriceCents(vpsTermPriceCents(plan.priceCents, months)) + ipCents + extraDiskCents`. Dedicated IP and extra disk get **neither** term discount nor promo (`order.ts:115,117-124`).

Promo is **first-term only**; renewals bill undiscounted `vpsTermPriceCents` (`order.ts:129-134`, `worker/billing.ts:111`). Always-on 15% "Launch Sale" fallback means a promo is *never* absent (`promotions.ts` `LAUNCH_SALE`, `currentPromo`); seasonal peaks at 45% Cyber Monday.

Plan prices (`prisma/seed.ts:12-16`): Nano $6.49, Starter $8.99, Standard $12.99, Pro $20.99, Max $32.99 /mo. `Plan` model — `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:253-268`. Admin CRUD is a thin `PlanForm` list — `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/plans/page.tsx:9-31` (RBAC `requireArea("billing")` at `:8`).

---

## 3. Wallet / card split + Stripe

**Shared helper: `walletSplit`** — `/opt/nxeon/lib/wallet-split.ts:33`. Deliberately dependency-free so client and server compute identical numbers (`wallet-split.ts:1-4`). `STRIPE_MIN_CENTS = 50` (`:11`); if `0 < card < 50` and wallet can't cover all, it forces exactly 50¢ onto the card and *reduces* wallet (`:50-54`).

Callers — server: `actions.ts:407` (deploy), `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server.ts:148` (upgrade), `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-disk.ts:85` (disk). Client: `DeployWizard.tsx:179`, `ResizePicker.tsx:78`, `AddStorage.tsx:79`.

**Key design (`actions.ts:424-430`, `stripe.ts:48-56`):** the card is charged **only the remainder**; on success the confirm path credits that card amount to the wallet and then debits the **full** charge — so the wallet is never touched before the card clears.

**Routes:**
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts` — wallet **top-up only**. Auth (`:7`), `stripeConfigured` (`:9`), max $5000 (`:14`), admin `min_topup_cents` default 500 (`:18-24`). *Note:* error copy says "$5–$5000" but no $5 floor is enforced — the real floor is the setting (`:14-24`).
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/stripe/confirm/route.ts` — success redirect. Delegates entirely to `fulfilCheckoutSession` (`:27`); on throw redirects to `?pending=1` and relies on the webhook (`:29-33`).
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` — verifies signature (`:15`), and on `checkout.session.completed` **fulfils** (`:34`). Errors swallowed on purpose so Stripe retries (`:29-37`).

**Idempotency — two independent layers:**
1. Wallet credit: `UNIQUE(WalletTransaction.stripeSessionId)`, P2002 = already credited — `/opt/nxeon/lib/stripe.ts:205-244`. Top-up invoice is created in the *same* transaction so it can't duplicate (`:227-239`).
2. Fulfilment: `FulfilledSession` row, `UNIQUE(stripeSessionId)` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/fulfil-checkout.ts:45-53`; model at `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:741-749` (status `CLAIMED|DONE|FAILED`).

**What commit `02a2bc4` ("P0-3") changed** (stat: confirm −103/+~20, webhook +20, new `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts` +148, schema +26):
- *Before:* fulfilment lived inline in the confirm route and was gated on `credited` — the boolean from `creditCheckoutSession`, true only for whoever won the **credit** race. Visible in the diff: `if (credited) { ... placeOrder ... }` else `redirect("/dashboard/servers")`.
- Two failure modes: (a) webhook's insert lands first → confirm gets P2002 → `credited === false` → silent empty redirect; money taken, no server, no notification. (b) customer closes the tab → confirm never runs → 100% reproducible same outcome. Applied equally to paid upgrades and disk expansions.
- *After:* one shared `fulfilCheckoutSession` called by **both** webhook and confirm; idempotency moved to its own `FulfilledSession` marker rather than the credit side effect (`fulfil-checkout.ts:64-70` explicitly discards the credit return value). Failures after claiming are recorded `FAILED` with reason and the customer gets a notification saying funds are safe in their wallet (`fulfil-checkout.ts:83-99`).

Fulfilment kinds dispatched: `order` → `placeOrder` (`:80`), `resize` → `applyResize` (`:109`), `diskExpand` → `applyDiskExpand` (`:131`), else plain `topup` (`:147`).

> Residual gap I could not resolve: a `FulfilledSession` left in `CLAIMED`/`FAILED` has **no reconciliation sweep** — no worker reads that table (grep: `fulfilledSession` appears only in `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts`). Recovery is manual.

---

## 4. Invoices

Model `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:510-531`. **Numbering:** `number Int @unique @default(autoincrement())` (`:512`), displayed zero-padded to 5 (`lib/invoices.ts:147`, `app/dashboard/invoices/page.tsx:62`). `refundedCents` tracks partial refunds (`:518-524`).

**Construction:** `invoiceCreateData` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/invoices.ts:72`. Returns a plain `data` payload (no DB touch) so each charge site can create the invoice **inside its own guarded transaction**, inheriting that charge's idempotency (`:65-71`). `amountCents` is always derived from line items + tax so the stamped total can't desync (`:82-83`). `createInvoice` (`:104`) is the direct-write variant.

**Rendering:** `renderInvoiceHTML` — `/opt/nxeon/lib/invoices.ts:141`. There is **no PDF library** (confirmed: no pdf/puppeteer/playwright in `package.json`); the documented approach is print-optimised CSS + a "Print / Save as PDF" button (`/opt/nxeon/app/api/invoices/[id]/route.ts:8-13`, button at `lib/invoices.ts:270`, `@media print` at `:262-266`).

**Routes:** `/opt/nxeon/app/api/invoices/[id]/route.ts` — owner-or-admin check (`:25-29`), returns `text/html` with `Cache-Control: private, no-store` (`:36`). List `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/invoices/page.tsx` (200 max, `:14`); detail `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:27`. Download anchor: `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/InvoiceViews.tsx` (`<a>` not `Link`, since target is raw HTML).

All 10 automatic charge sites create `status: "PAID"`: `order.ts:212`, `actions.ts:321,652`, `resize.ts:126`, `disk-expand.ts:176`, `stripe.ts:231`, `worker/billing.ts:147,561`, `worker/product-renewals.ts:174,352`, `actions-domains-transfer.ts:268`. `OPEN` invoices come **only** from admin actions (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-billing.ts:39,118`) and are informational — `generateInvoiceForServer` explicitly "does not charge the wallet" (`:12-16`).

**Not wired:** `taxCents` is **never** passed by any charge path — every real invoice has tax 0, yet the HTML and both detail pages render a "Tax" line (`lib/invoices.ts:326`, `app/dashboard/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:103`, `app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:132`). `lib/tax.ts` is used only for display on admin products/affiliate pages and `components/TaxLine.tsx` — never for invoicing.

---

## 5. Renewals, dunning, grace, suspension

**Timer:** both sweeps run from one loop every **10 minutes** — `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:1042-1052` (`billingSweep()` at `:1045`, `productRenewalSweep()` at `:1051`). Base poll `POLL_MS = 3000` (`:34`).

**Constants** (`/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts:27-34`): `GRACE_DAYS=3` (`NXEON_GRACE_DAYS`), `TERMINATE_DAYS=10`, `WARN_BEFORE_TERMINATE_DAYS=2`, `DOMAIN_RENEW_WINDOW_DAYS=7`. `RENEW_DAYS = 30` at `:28` is **dead** (declared, never referenced).

**VPS state machine** (all offsets relative to `expiresAt = E`):

| Point | Behaviour | Cite |
|---|---|---|
| E−3d | "renews soon — action needed" notification, but **only** if renewal would fail (auto-renew off or balance short); deduped over 4 days | `billing.ts:53-88` (skip at `:68`) |
| E+0 | If `autoRenew`: CAS on `expiresAt` → `debitWallet` → wallet txn → PAID invoice → audit, all in one tx | `billing.ts:124-177` |
| E+0…E+3d (grace) | Renewal failed → server keeps running, nothing else this pass | `billing.ts:190-192` |
| E+3d | `suspendReason: "UNPAID"` + `suspendedNote`, `SUSPEND` job, audit, notification. Gated on zero in-flight jobs | `billing.ts:192-219` |
| E+11d (`terminateAt − 2d`) | "will be deleted soon" notification, deduped 2 days | `billing.ts:452-471` |
| E+13d (`GRACE+TERMINATE`) | `status: DELETING` + `DELETE` job + audit + notification — **permanent** | `billing.ts:431,434-451` |

Renewal amount (`billing.ts:109-116`): undiscounted `vpsTermPriceCents` + IP surcharge **only if a real `DedicatedIp` row exists** (not the intent flag, `:112-115`) + extra disk × months. Manual `renewNow` mirrors this — `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:615-618`.

Double-charge protection everywhere: compare-and-swap on `expiresAt` throwing `AlreadyRenewedError` (`billing.ts:25,129-133`; `actions.ts:635-639`), with the explicit warning that the loop's snapshot balance is stale and must never gate the charge (`billing.ts:118-122`).

**Add-on products** (`/opt/nxeon/worker/product-renewals.ts`): policy stated at `:28-34`. Decision logic is pure in `/opt/nxeon/lib/product-billing.ts` — `renewalDecision` (`:153-165`) returns `renew|grace|enforce`; `PRODUCT_GRACE_DAYS` shares `NXEON_GRACE_DAYS` (`:31`), `PRODUCT_WARN_DAYS=3` (`:34`). Enforcement is deliberately non-destructive: email → `SUSPENDED`, mailboxes kept (`product-renewals.ts:209-234`); volume → `DETACHED` + `VOLUME_DETACH` job, data kept (`:385-456`). `PRODUCT_RECLAIM_DAYS` is **messaging only** — nothing deletes (`product-billing.ts:36-42`).

**`Server.suspendReason` — `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:329`**, values `"UNPAID" | "ABUSE" | "ADMIN"`, null = never suspended (documented `:315-328`).

| Value | Set at | Cleared at |
|---|---|---|
| `UNPAID` | `/opt/nxeon/worker/billing.ts:203` | `actions.ts:637` (renewNow), `worker/index.ts:464,512` |
| `ABUSE` | `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-abuse.ts:42` | as above |
| `ADMIN` | `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:779` | `actions.ts:780` (unsuspend) |

Consumed at exactly two places, both scoped strictly to `UNPAID`: `worker/billing.ts:426` (`terminateOverdue` selector) and `lib/actions.ts:690` (renewNow auto-unsuspend).

**Commit `78407bd` ("P0-8")** — the bug was that `suspendedNote` was the only signal distinguishing suspension types **and nothing consumed it**:

- **(a) Data destruction.** `terminateOverdue` selected on `status: "SUSPENDED"` alone (diff: `where: { isFree: false, status: "SUSPENDED", expiresAt: { not: null } }`), while the renewal sweep *excludes* suspended servers (`billing.ts:94` restricts to `RUNNING`/`STOPPED`). So an admin suspending a paid-up customer pending abuse review meant that customer was never charged and never warned; the term lapsed untouched and **13 days later the VM and all its data were destroyed** with a "prolonged non-payment" notice they'd never had a chance to act on — while having auto-renew on and a funded wallet.
- **(b) Abuse-control bypass.** `renewNow` auto-unsuspended *any* suspended server on payment, so a spammer suspended for outbound abuse could pay and put themselves straight back on the network — reversing an administrative decision with a card.

**Why `suspendReason` exists:** it gives the billing engine the *cause*, so destructive automation and self-service unsuspend can both scope to `UNPAID` only. Legacy rows with `suspendReason = null` are excluded from **both** — the stated rationale being asymmetric risk: "failing to terminate costs disk, wrongly terminating is unrecoverable" (`billing.ts:419-421`).

## 6. Proration

`/opt/nxeon/lib/proration.ts` — pure, no server-only imports, mirroring `wallet-split.ts` so displayed == charged (`:1-4`).

**Exports:**
```ts
MS_PER_AVG_MONTH = 30.44 * 86400_000                                    // :10
remainingMonths(expiresAt: Date|null, now: number, capMonths?: number): number   // :20
prorateDeltaCents(opts: { fromMonthlyCents, toMonthlyCents, termMonths,
                          monthsRemaining, promo?, now? }): number      // :45
prorateUpgradeCents(opts: same): number                                 // :61
prorateDowngradeCreditCents(opts: same): number                         // :66
```

**Formula** (`:53-57`) — both directions price through the *same* function so they cannot drift:
```
eff(m)  = promoPriceCents(vpsEffectiveMonthly(m, termMonths), promo)
delta   = eff(toMonthlyCents) − eff(fromMonthlyCents)
result  = round(delta × max(0, monthsRemaining))
```
i.e. term discount → promo → × months left. `promo` defaults to `currentPromo(now)` = what a fresh order would pay today. Upgrade clamps ≥0 (`:62`), downgrade returns `max(0, −delta)` (`:69`).

`remainingMonths` = `max(0, (expiresAt − now) / MS_PER_AVG_MONTH)`, optionally capped by `capMonths` (`:22-23`). The cap matters on the **credit** side: `renewNow` can stack `expiresAt` many terms out, and an unclamped credit multiplies the delta by every stacked month (`:12-19`).

**Every caller (`rg`):**

| Caller | Function | Cap? |
|---|---|---|
| `/opt/nxeon/lib/resize.ts:79-84` | `prorateUpgradeCents` (server, upgrade) | no cap (`:83`) |
| `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/ResizePicker.tsx:66-71` | `prorateUpgradeCents` (client estimate) | no cap (`:70`) |
| `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:185-190` | `prorateDowngradeCreditCents` | capped `server.termMonths` (`:189`) |

Imports at `resize.ts:7`, `ResizePicker.tsx:7`, `actions-server-lifecycle.ts:9`. Client/server agree on upgrades (both uncapped); the cap is credit-side only — consistent with the docstring.

Rationale recorded at `proration.ts:26-44` and `resize.ts:70-78`: the old code used the **raw list-price delta**. On a 36-month term with a 30% promo, upgrading cost **$1,044.45 vs $665.08** to buy the target plan outright for the same end date — a $379.37 overcharge. The mirror image was worse in kind: the downgrade credit used the same undiscounted delta, refunding more than was ever paid.

**Two modules bypass `lib/proration.ts` entirely** — worth flagging for the manual:
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/disk-expand.ts:124-125` computes proration inline and imports `MS_PER_AVG_MONTH` from `lib/resize.ts:10` (a **duplicate** of the same constant).
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/AddStorage.tsx:17` **re-declares** `MS_PER_AVG_MONTH = 30.44 * 86400_000` client-side and recomputes at `:66-73`.

Three copies of one constant, only one of which is the canonical export. Values agree today; nothing enforces that.

## 7. NOT wired / stale / simulated

**A. No card auto-charge on renewal — the single biggest gap.**
- `Server.dunningStage` / `dunningNextAt` / `dunningPayUrl` (`/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma:331-346`) are **never read or written anywhere** — grep across all `.ts`/`.tsx` returns zero hits outside the schema.
- No saved-payment-method machinery exists at all: zero hits for `off_session`, `paymentIntents.create`, `SetupIntent`, `stripeCustomerId`, `stripePaymentMethodId` (the only mention is a comment in `/opt/nxeon/app/api/account/export/route.ts:129`).
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/mailer.ts:218-236` documents "Renewals apply wallet credit first, then auto-charge the customer's saved card… we retry on day 1, 3 and 5", with `DUNNING_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 3` (`:236`). **None of this exists.** Templates `paymentReceipt` (`:340`), `paymentFailed` (`:287`), `paymentRetryFailed` (`:370`), `paymentActionRequired` (`:415`) have **no callers** — the only reference is the admin previewer (`/opt/nxeon/app/admin/email-templates/page.tsx:87,92`), and it uses the *legacy* arg shape.
- Actual behaviour: renewal is **wallet-only**. `debitWallet` fails → grace → suspend (`worker/billing.ts:180-219`).

**B. Renewals send notifications, never email.** Zero hits for `sendMail`/`mailer`/`sendEmail` in `worker/billing.ts` or `worker/product-renewals.ts`. There are **no day-offset dunning emails** — only in-app `db.notification` rows. (`lib/stripe.ts:250-257` does email a top-up receipt, so the mailer works; it just isn't wired to renewals.)

**C. Admin dunning settings are decorative.** `dunning_grace_days=3` / `dunning_warn_days=7` / `dunning_terminate_days=14` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/settings.ts:39-41`) are editable in the UI (`/opt/nxeon/components/admin/settings/BillingPanel.tsx:24-26`) and persisted (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-settings.ts:48-50`), but `worker/billing.ts:27-33` reads **env vars** instead. The admin panel's warn/terminate values (7/14) don't even match the env defaults (2/10) — an operator changing them sees no effect.

**D. Stale comment.** `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:212` says `INTEGRATION NEEDED: worker must honour payload.prorateCents/direction` — but `/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:894-925` (`reconcileFailedJob`) *does* honour both, refunding on `direction: "up"` and clawing back on `"down"`. The comment is obsolete.

**E. Downgrades unreachable in practice.** `/opt/nxeon/lib/resize.ts:65-67` hard-blocks downgrades in the upgrade path; `resizeServerDown` exists but its disk-monotonic guard (`actions-server-lifecycle.ts:161-166`) blocks every downgrade the live 5-plan catalogue permits (disk and price both rise monotonically). Noted in-code at `:176-182`.

**F. Best-effort/silent paths.** Domain auto-renew can renew at the registrar and fail to charge, logging `domain.renew.uncharged` for manual collection (`worker/billing.ts:579-589`). `maybeRewardReferral` and receipt email are swallowed (`order.ts:286-290`, `stripe.ts:246-257`). Webhook errors swallowed by design (`webhook/route.ts:35-37`).

**G. Stripe metadata is 490 chars.** The order intent round-trips through `metadata.nxeonOrder` truncated to 490 (`/opt/nxeon/lib/stripe.ts:41`); SSH keys are stripped to fit (`:26-27`) and `extraDiskGB` is left `undefined` rather than `0` purely to save bytes (`order.ts:75-80`). A silent truncation would corrupt the intent — no length assertion exists.

**H. Sandbox mode** simulates jobs generally (`/opt/nxeon/lib/sandbox.ts:5`) but I found **no** simulated branch in any billing/charge path — money movement is real in all modes.
